answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must stake assets into a progressive bonding curve where validation demands recursive cryptographic attestation chains. Each identity verifies hardware integrity via zero-knowledge proofs, projecting verification across a prism of trust. Every swarm replica drains resources like a river emptying into a drought, ensuring exponential capital exhaustion: while a single agent anchors like a marble, creating $N$ clones incurs superlinear cost $O(2^N)$ that financially breaks adversaries.
